name: Okta: Operational Directory Agents with Delegated Authentication
description: Operational Okta AD and LDAP agents associated with applications configured for outbound delegated authentication.
cypher:
MATCH (agent:Okta_Agent {operational_status: 'OPERATIONAL'})-[:Okta_AgentMemberOf]->(:Okta_AgentPool)-[:Okta_AgentPoolFor]->(app:Okta_Application)
WHERE 'OUTBOUND_DEL_AUTH' IN app.features
AND agent.type IN ['AD', 'LDAP']
RETURN agent
